title: A 100 kW methane fire and its plume

fuel.source: methane: molar mass 16.043 g/mol; heat of combustion 50.0 MJ/kg (lower heating value, Drysdale, An Introduction to Fire Dynamics, 3rd ed., 2011); 17.2 kg of air per kg from CH4 + 2 (O2 + 3.76 N2); radiative fraction 0.2, the value fire models take for methane flames of this size (a demonstration value: it is not radiated here, only removed)

burner.source: a porous square burner 0.3 m across, as in McCaffrey's experiments (1979)
